description: FastAPI route definitions for managing run configurations, including create, list, retrieve, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create_run_config
methods.description: Creates a new run configuration using provided data.

methods.name: list_run_configs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all run configurations with pagination.

methods.name: get_run_config
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific run configuration by ID.

methods.name: update_run_config
methods.description: Updates an existing run configuration identified by ID.

methods.name: delete_run_config
methods.description: Deletes a run configuration by ID.
